title: CIA / World Spiritual Bank — Shared Institution
concept: CIA — Characters, Incidents & Associations and the World Spiritual Bank are one project institution with different entrances. The archive entrance emphasizes people, scenes and relationships; the bank entrance emphasizes accounts, obligations, repair and system ledgers. Both read and write the same provenance spine.
reader_position_note: Public CIA, dossier, association, incident and bank pages are treated as rooms inside the institution. Navigation between them is an internal corridor rather than a jump between unrelated mini-sites.

entrances.label: Archive entrance
entrances.purpose: Enter through files, chronology, people and recovered evidence.

entrances.label: Bank entrance
entrances.purpose: Enter through accounts, obligations, welfare, repair and system liabilities.

rooms.label: Filing Hall
rooms.function: Searchable cabinet, archive authority and recovery triage.

rooms.label: Dossier Reading Room
rooms.function: One subject at a time: identity, chronology, meaning spine, roles, sources, media and symbolic account.

rooms.label: Associations Room
rooms.function: Relationship and co-presence edges with dates, contexts and evidence boundaries.

rooms.label: Incidents Room
rooms.function: Dated scenes that materially change the archive.

rooms.label: Bank Counter
rooms.function: Reader-facing fictional sUSD statements, Dooley Welfare and event-led account posture.

rooms.label: Account Vault
rooms.function: Dossier-level credit, debit, dispute, repair and welfare entries; every priced movement must retain source provenance.

rooms.label: System Ledger Vault
rooms.function: Unpriced world/system liability domains kept separate from person-level accounts.

rooms.label: North / Root Records
rooms.function: Custody, memory, provenance and long-form ledger topology.

rooms.label: Ladder Clearing
rooms.function: Repair, restitution, correction, forgiveness/closure rules and restored exit capacity without erasing history.

flows.meaning: A person is found in the cabinet, read as a dossier, then opened as an account without losing identity context.
Evidence enters as dated scenes/relations before it can become a sourced dossier or ledger event.
Individual statements remain distinct from larger system domains and world-scale symbolic topology.
Repair changes current posture while the historical record remains visible.

interface_rules: Preserve the selected character when moving between dossier and bank when a character query parameter exists.
Show the reader where they are inside the institution and provide internal-room exits before generic site navigation.
Archive evidence must precede priced account movement; an archetype or insult cannot itself create debt.
Person-level fictional balances and system/world symbolic liabilities remain visually and mathematically distinct.
The same building metaphor must never imply affiliation with the real U.S. Central Intelligence Agency, a real bank, court or intelligence service.
boundaries: This is project architecture and narrative interface design, not a claim that a real CIA/bank hybrid institution exists.
CIA here means Characters, Incidents & Associations.
World Spiritual Bank and sUSD are fictional Potatoverse accounting devices.
No symbolic balance is objective morality, human worth, legal liability or real financial debt.

contextual_entrances.rule: Primary symbolic entrance. Both departments can be presented openly because the reader is already inside project-canon space.
Enter CIA for people/scenes/associations while Culture retains ownership of cultural mechanisms.
Use when platform fragments become dossier recovery work; platform evidence remains owned by the platform/archive layers.
A deliberately bounded symbolic-finance threshold. Real central banks, debt, trade, institutions and geopolitical evidence remain World Systems owners.

threshold_copy_policy.principle: Keep boundaries compact and local to the threshold rather than flattening sober pages with repeated disclaimers.
threshold_copy_policy.preferred_tone: fine print, dry humor, clearly authored
threshold_copy_policy.shorthand: mythic archive based on a true story
must_preserve: real-world source material may appear in dossiers
symbolic interpretation begins at the threshold
CIA is not the U.S. Central Intelligence Agency
World Spiritual Bank is not real finance
symbolic accounts do not become empirical world-system facts
